name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-01-26, at wavelengths from 1.45 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
